avis.texte: Great product. Experienced no irritation or dryness and I've been using it for about 6 months, 3-4 times a week at night. Definitely helps with diminishing fine lines and wrinkles. Use this plus the Honey Halo moisturizer and you will feel and see a difference in your skin!

Not the strongest retinol I've used yet it works really well. Perfect mix of ingredients and actually feels hydrating as well. I noticed results after about 2 weeks using 3-4 times per week. Best overall retinol as I keep trying others yet continually come back to this one. Doesn't irritate sensitive skin either.

This is the best retinol I've tried as someone with sensitive combination skin! It's not too harsh or drying and it's so effective! I've been using this for about a year and have noticed a significant decrease in wrinkles and improvement in texture. Even my esthetician noticed my skin get better over the last year. Please never discontinue this!!
I was worried about retinol aggravating my sensitive skin, but I've been using this product 3 times a week and I can tell a difference when I wake up. Love it and would recommend

I'm new to retinols but I have immediately seen results using this serum. The very first night I used it I woke up to radiant plumper looking skin. I've been using it for about two weeks and it's been fantastic. I can't wait to see what my skin looks like after months of consistent use.
The % Vitamin A Retinol Serum boosts skin texture and reduces fine lines. With GrabOn discounts, it's an excellent value for a top-notch anti-aging treatment.
I've only recently started using, but it love how lightweight and refreshing it feels.

Obsessed with this serum! I'm 26 so fine lines and deep wrinkles aren't a major issue-yet, but this product has been smoothing lines I honestly didn't even realize I had! Lol. I received a sample and started religiously using it and I cannot even believe how much it has benefitted my skin. So so smooth and has helped my moisture barrier so much. Doesn't smell amazing or anything but I know this is common with retinol and the benefits outweigh everything else, plus it's not an overpowering smell whatsoever. WILL be buying a full size before I run out of my mini!

I've been using it for 2 months now pretty religiously and I can honestly say my fine lines are "finer". I've been using honeymoon glow as well, swapping them out on certain nights. Just reordered this retinol because I love how quickly my skin absorbs it. It's a great addition to anyone's night time routine.

I have been nervous about trying retinol since I have sensitive skin, but so far this has not been too drying. I like the consistency, a little seems to go a long way. My only complaint is that it stinks like expired lipstick. Apparently this is normal, but another reviewer said that it smells nice and fresh..so I'm not convinced I didn't get an old one!

I have tried multiple retinol products and had to discontinue all of them due to my skin breaking out with huge, cystic bumps and also milia. Even with time my skin did not show enough benefit to continue working through the breakouts. UNTIL this retinol serum that not only doesn't break me out, but has even reduced my hormonal acne. It is also doing wonders for my dark spots (though I am also using the dark spot toner). I am almost to the point of not wearing makeup to work, that is how good my skin looks since starting this product!
I look at photos from a couple of years ago before I started using this, and I can totally see that my face is brighter and that fine lines are less noticeable.

I received a sample of this with my last order and used it all up. I have never used retinol before and was honestly timid to start because I wanted to make sure I chose the right product. After this sample, I liked how well my skin absorbed it and felt after application. I feel like this product is the perfect starting point for retinol use. I'm buying the full size and hopefully it works as well as the sample did!

I did some research and found that the Farmacy retinol serum was what I should start with because of the encapsulated retinol. I also liked the ingredients list---this formulation is really good. I plan to repurchase. I've heard experts say to start with a lower percentage but this seems to work for me. I started out 1-2x a week and then increased it after that. I have been using it for about 4-5 weeks. That said, I would have given this five stars but there is an oil in the formula that makes it smell like it is rancid. I do not know which oil could go rancid in the bottle or maybe that is the scent of the product. I haven't had a reaction (yet) but if this is a problem, something should be done. I would hate for the formula to change but I want stable ingredients.
This retinol is great! I love how easily it absorbs into my skin and always leaves me feeling great. I've noticed smaller pores and my skin is more glowy!
This is a gentle and effective retinol. I always feel like I look better in the morning after using this. It visibly firms my skin and makes it look more clear and vibrant.

I have been using other retinol,I am glad that I gave myself Chance to try Farmacy and I love it. It made my skin firmer, smooth and it gives me poreless skin. And best part is it doesn't irritates my skin thank goodness!!

First thing I noticed is how amazing this product smells. it's fresh and does not have a harsh chemical smell at all. It's silky smooth and goes on the skin with ease. I use this when my skin is starting to show signs of acne and it helps detox and clear up my pores immediately. Highly recommend this product!!
A great addition to my routine, this works great with the overnight pore refinement mask. I woke up with a smooth youthful look and feel.
It really works for my skin. It lessens the aging in my face. Im Buying a bigger size!
I've been using this retinol A for 3 weeks and have already noticed a huge difference in my skin! I love that it's also hydrating so my skin isn't dry or red, which is a huge plus!
This is my second bottle. Not drying as a prescription retinol.

This works very well for wrinkles. I'm 27 and very expressive. I was using just the filling good serum but wanted something a bit less moisturizing for the summer and this is perfect. I don't get many wrinkles at my age but saw some line emerging on my forehead and they're already gone. It works really well under my makeup too.
i'm not old but i already for smile lines and this helped a lot, now my makeup doesn't crease there anymore
All farmacy products i have used have left skin soft and glowy ..I esp like the Honey Halo ceratonin cream and the Honey Potion they are a powerful duo for soft ,healthy growing skin
It makes my skin feel so good. My pores look better and I can really see and feel the difference.
Makes my skin so tight and glowy! Use 1-3 times a week and always notice my Skin looks excellent alll day
I love the way this serum makes my skin feel. I use it 1-2 times a week.
Huge changes in my skin since using this! My texture is so much smoother and my redness is so much better.

avis.titre: Effective with a lovely feel and scent
avis.texte: Other retinols have produced texture on my skin. This has helped smooth texture, feels lovely, and has a nice scent. My only con is that I do need to use more product to cover my face and neck, though I may just need to adjust technique. I use 3-4x/week, alternating with a chemical exfoliant.

avis.titre: Noticeable differences in just a couple weeks
avis.texte: I used to use the Cera Ve Resurfacing Retinol Serum, but decided to give Farmacy's retinol a try because I love all of the products I've tried from them. Although there is a discernable price difference between the two, I would highly recommend the one from Farmacy since I noticed improvements in skin texture including fine lines in just a couple of weeks. I can use it without a moisturizer and it is non irritating. I didn't have any negative reactions to this product. I use one to two pumps for my entire face every other night and I wake up with baby smooth skin.
Love how this makes my skin feel and look. Stay consistent and you will See results!
I like the product and got good results, got this product with the best discount from the GrabOn page.

This isn't the first retinol I've used, but it's definitely the best! I see results in my fine lines using 2x a week, and as long as I moisturize after (honey halo!) I have no irritation and minimal dryness. Also I do have sensitive skin and I'm able to use this with no itching, burning, or redness. Will purchase again!
Only used for a few weeks but I feel like I can see the difference! Excited to see its full results later
First time I've tried this serum,although I've only been using it 2 weeks my skin feels silky smooth. I will definitely be buying it again!

Hydrating enough to use on its own and doesn't tingle, burn or irritate my sensitive skin. I use it only 3x per week out of caution of past experience but it's going to be a staple in my routine!

I use this 2-3x/week at night in my skincare routine and do not have any irritation. It absorbs quickly, and I layer the Honey Halo or 10% Niacinamide Mask on top. The packaging is great and does not allow air to impact the product effectiveness.
I have been using this for a few weeks and so far so good! it is easy to use with minimal irritation.

I have been using The Ordinary products layered under Farmacy's Honey Halo (my all time favorite). When this item first came out, I wanted to give it a try but never thought I would like it as much or more than The Ordinary. I prefer to use all products within the same brand to keep things simple and I am pleased to say that I love these new products by Farmacy. My face feels amazingly soft, smooth, and supple. I found the only way I can achieve these results is by layering good and effective products. Thank you for coming out with such amazing (and clean) products!
I started using this not too long ago and I love it! I never had any issues with using this product and it makes my skin feel amazing! I have gotten so many compliments on my skin.
This retinol formula is smooth and has very little skin dryness effects. After the first couple of uses, my skin adjusted and any dryness disappeared. Loving it so far!

I had lines between my eyes due to headaches and stress from me scrunching my face for the past 6 years of work work work! Decided to try it and within a month or so the lines were gone. I was so happy and confused on how amazing this product is. Wish I found it sooner!
Super hydrating retinol! Not drying in the least, feels silky and smooth. Consistency couldn't be more luxury!
This is really good and has completely changed my skin. I have dark spots that are fading. My wrinkles are fading too. Farmacys Retinol with A is amazing, highly recommend!
Another great product. I was pleasantly surprised how much I liked this serum. I noticed a difference after a weeks use. It really did seem to soften fine lines around my eyes.

I don't need to add any moisturizers, my acne has decreased, I have no sensitivity, my skin is vibrant and glowy every single morning. I'm blown away. I have been using this for about 6 weeks now and love it so far! I'm starting to see abit of a difference in my skin and so happy!
